rules.title: What an expense records
rules.text: When you add an expense, the CLI shall record its amount, payer, people, note and date.

sources.says: When you add an expense, the CLI shall record its amount, payer, people, note and date.

rules.title: An amount that is not a number
rules.text: If the amount is not a number, then the CLI shall stop with "Amount must be a number".

sources.says: If the amount is not a number, then the CLI shall stop with "Amount must be a number".

rules.title: A payer outside the group
rules.text: If the payer is not in the group, then the CLI shall stop with "Unknown person".

sources.says: If the payer is not in the group, then the CLI shall stop with "Unknown person".

rules.title: Who shares a cost by default
rules.text: When you leave out --for, the CLI shall split the cost among everyone in the group.

sources.says: When you leave out --for, the CLI shall split the cost among everyone in the group.

rules.title: Money in whole cents
rules.text: The ledger shall keep money in whole cents.

sources.says: The ledger shall keep money in whole cents.

rules.title: Each person's balance
rules.text: When you run tally split, the CLI shall show each person's balance.

sources.says: When you run tally split, the CLI shall show each person's balance.

rules.title: The fewest payments
rules.text: The split shall suggest the fewest payments that settle everyone.

sources.says: The split shall suggest the fewest payments that settle everyone.

rules.title: When everyone is even
rules.text: If everyone is even, then the CLI shall say "Everyone is even".

sources.says: If everyone is even, then the CLI shall say "Everyone is even".

rules.title: The order of the report
rules.text: When you run tally report, the CLI shall list each expense by date, oldest first.

sources.says: When you run tally report, the CLI shall list each expense by date, oldest first.

rules.title: A report from a date
rules.text: When you give --since, the report shall show only the expenses from that date on.

sources.says: When you give --since, the report shall show only the expenses from that date on.

rules.title: A missing ledger
rules.text: If the ledger file is missing, then the CLI shall start an empty ledger.

sources.says: If the ledger file is missing, then the CLI shall start an empty ledger.

rules.title: A damaged ledger
rules.text: If the ledger file is damaged, then the CLI shall stop and change nothing.

sources.says: If the ledger file is damaged, then the CLI shall stop and change nothing.

rules.title: Currency
rules.text: The ledger shall keep one currency per group, set in .tally.json.

rules.title: CSV reports
rules.text: When you give --format csv, the report shall print the expenses as CSV.

rules.title: Rounding
rules.text: If a cost does not split evenly, then the split shall give the extra cent to the first person in the split.

sources.says: If a cost does not split evenly, then the split shall give the extra cent to the first person in the split.

rules.important: It decides who pays the extra cent.

rules.title: Refunds
rules.text: If the amount is below zero, then the CLI shall record a refund.

sources.says: If the amount is below zero, then the CLI shall record a refund.

rules.important: It changes what a negative amount means in the ledger.

rules.title: Where the ledger lives
rules.text: The ledger shall live in .tally.json in the folder where you run tally.

sources.says: The ledger shall live in .tally.json in the folder where you run tally.

rules.important: It decides which ledger each command reads and writes.
